title: Learnable Hodge-Laplacian Driven Mixture of Experts for Steady-PDE Surrogates on Coarse Unstructured Meshes
abstract: arXiv:2610.20585v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current approaches for steady partial differential equations surrogate models on unstructured meshes apply a single mixing mechanism to the whole solution. This paper proposes an architecture that partitions the solution among vanilla transformer experts, each focused on a different spectral scale. The partition is built from a discrete Hodge Laplacian $L_0=\star_0^{-1} d_0^{\top}\star_1 d_0$, that serves as a fitting layer measuring high-frequency content. A gating mechanism takes the mesh as input and produces the per-vertex weights that recombine the expert outputs. AirFRANS is a steady Reynolds-averaged Navier--Stokes (RANS) airfoil benchmark. We evaluate our approach in a reduced remeshed version of the benchmark with each unstructured mesh counting 9.6K faces and 4.9K vertices. We compare our approach with the Transolver on the same dataset and dataset slit. Our approach reduces relative $L_2$ error by 31\% and interior mean square

translated_title: 可学习霍奇-拉普拉斯驱动的混合专家模型用于粗非结构网格上的稳态偏微分方程代理模型
translated_abstract: 当前针对非结构网格上稳态偏微分方程代理模型的方法对整个解应用单一的混合机制。本文提出了一种新架构，将解划分给多个标准transformer专家，每个专家专注于不同的频谱尺度。该划分由离散霍奇-拉普拉斯算子 $L_0=\star_0^{-1} d_0^{\top}\star_1 d_0$ 构建，作为测量高频内容的拟合层。门控机制以网格为输入，生成逐顶点权重以重新组合各专家的输出。AirFRANS是一个稳态雷诺平均Navier-Stokes（RANS）翼型基准测试。我们在该基准的精简重网格化版本上评估了所提方法，每个非结构网格包含9.6K个面和4.9K个顶点。我们在相同的数据集和数据集划分上与Transolver进行了对比。我们的方法将相对$L_2$误差降低了31%，并降低了内部均方误差。
tldr: 该论文提出一种由可学习霍奇-拉普拉斯算子驱动的混合专家架构，将解按频谱尺度分配给不同transformer专家并通过逐顶点门控权重重组，在粗非结构网格稳态PDE代理任务上相比Transolver将相对$L_2$误差降低了31%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a learnable Hodge-Laplacian driven mixture-of-experts architecture that partitions solutions among transformer experts specialized in different spectral scales with per-vertex gating, reducing relative L2 error by 31% over Transolver for steady PDE surrogates on coarse unstructured meshes.
